title: Sundar Pichai says Google is now processing 3.2 quadrillion tokens per month, up from 480T tokens per month a year ago and 9.7T tokens per month two years ago (Ina Fried/Axios)
summary: Ina Fried / Axios: Sundar Pichai says Google is now processing 3.2 quadrillion tokens per month, up from 480T tokens per month a year ago and 9.7T tokens per month two years ago — Google used its I/O developer conference on Tuesday to showcase how deeply it plans to embed AI across its products …
